• Began to rebound last year which led to improved business confidence.
• Various macroeconomic factors impacted both the banking industry and
the country’s economy.
• GDP grew at an estimated 5.5 percent from 4.9 percent in 2017.
• CBK reduced the interest rate to 9 percent in July 2018 from 9.5
percent.
• Exchange rate stability in 2018 as compared to 2017
• The Govt’s Big Four Agenda focusing on manufacturing, affordable
housing, universal health coverage and food and nutrition security
expected to provide opportunities
• Global environment will continue to impact the economy – key amongst
them being the trade wars attributed to Brexit, commodity prices and
the US monetary policy
